November 15, 2024

# `manualPaymentGateway` field added to `orderTransaction` object

DateNovember 15, 2024

Version[2025-01](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-01)

FlagsUpdate

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)[Admin REST API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-rest)

As of GraphQL Admin API version 2025-01, the `manualPaymentGateway` field will be added to `orderTransaction` object. This field indicates if the transaction is processed by a manual payment gateway.
